title: Perfect-immersion tensor formula with independent derived localizations
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a proper closed immersion of Noetherian schemes, with independent derived localizations on Z,Y and compatible localization universe on every open of Y. Assume the single complex i_*O_Z[0] is perfect on Y. Let c be the specified right adjoint to the quasi-coherent restriction of Ri*, with a given preservation witness. Let OP be a quasi-coherent object isomorphic to O_Y[0]. For every K in D_QCoh(Y), there is an isomorphism c(K) ≅ L i*(K) tensor^L c(OP) in D(Z), where the pullback is [def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes]. The result does not assume i is a diagonal or that a flat proper f or its adjoint is given.

proof.text: Transfer perfection to the standard pushforward of the tensor unit by lem-sc-perfect-immersion-standard-perfection. Apply the proved lem-pc-derived-qcoh-standard-adjunction to conjugate the supplied right adjunction, obtaining qY, cS, their natural inclusion comparisons and a standard preservation witness.

Apply lem-sc-smooth-proper-diagonal-tensor-formula in the standard localizations at qY(K). Form its specified adjunction mate; its invertibility gives an isomorphism in the full QCoh subcategory. Apply inclusion and invert it. The Qh localization comparison at the single O_Y gives the standard unit comparison. Compose with hOP and map through cS to identify the right factor.

Map the standard tensor formula through the inverse ambient comparison on Z, using the comparison of c(K). Apply lem-pc-derived-localization-tensor-comparison. The left factor comparison is the pullback functor applied to the inclusion comparison of K, by the definition def-pc-derived-pullback-across-universes. The right factor comparison uses the cS comparison at OP and the equivalence unit on c(OP). Tensor these factor isomorphisms and compose, giving the original orientation.

proof_origin.place: Tags 0A9U and 0BRT with 05RU localization uniqueness. Q2 wrote and compiled adjunction conjugation, structure-unit comparison, invertible-mate extraction and tensor-isomorphism composition. Tensor compatibility and standard perfection are split into their strictly smaller comparison statements.
